svg.aria-label: An 8-bit pixel-art office on a white background: a green LED wall sign reads DEMOVERSE HQ — AGENTS AT WORK above two agents sitting at desks typing on green-on-black CRT terminals; on a loop, one picks up the phone and closes a deal — their CRT flashes WON with a big checkmark while they throw their arms up and cheer under falling confetti and gold coins — then the two chat in a speech-bubble exchange, the other takes a call and wins a deal of their own, and everyone goes back to typing.
